camera.description: Terra opens a doorway of light showing an unpopulated Ninevian wilderness beyond it.

balloons.text: Our concentrated mana would poison its people.

balloons.text: Where did all the color go?

balloons.text: Perception differs from world to world.
When we enter one, we are perceived through the language by which that world understands reality.
That is not the same as the Domain.
No. The Domain is perceived with greater clarity than the worlds below.

balloons.text: As soon as they believe the danger has passed, they will return to what they were.

blocking.description: Terra faces Joan-a. Zorna stands slightly behind Terra, examining Joan-a’s excessive collection of evidence.

balloons.text: You may eventually be proven right.

balloons.text: I was thrown out of an airlock.
I spent three days inside a fish.
It was called the Big Fish.
It vomited me into a garbage heap.
Your mission was to warn Nineva, not ensure its destruction.
They listened. That must be enough.

actions.description: Zorna unsuccessfully suppresses a laugh. Joan-a glares at her.
Joan-a reluctantly hands Terra the collected evidence. Terra opens a doorway back to the Domain.
